name: branding-blue-orange-yellow-palette-type-and-icon-board
title: Bento brand board: blue ramp, warm gradient, type specimen, hex stripes and orbit icon
whatItIs: A white grid of rounded tiles: a stepped blue ramp, an orange-yellow gradient, a Let's talk button, a cream typeface card with 'Roobert', a navy specimen tile with AaBbCc and numerals, an orange gradient tile with a white orbit-heart icon, and vertical colour bars with hex codes.
whatItMeans: Friendly and optimistic; cool blue with sunny gradients feels warm and approachable.
techniques: Arrange all identity parts as a bento of rounded tiles.
Show colour as ramps, gradients and labelled bars together.
Render type as a giant specimen on a dark tile.
Use a gradient tile for the icon.

vocabulary.definition: A modular grid summarising a brand.
A stepped series of tones of one hue.
A tile filled with a colour blend.
A vertical swatch labelled with its code.
